summary: Sensofusion Oyj develops and manufactures anti-drone systems for military and law enforcement applications. The company's primary product is Airfence that functions as a passive drone detection and response system that provides real-time location identification of drones and their operators. It also offers Airfence Military Edition, which incorporates countermeasures against modern drone threats for combat use. In addition, the company provides system extensions that complement its anti-drone systems. It serves governmental, security, and military customers across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia. Sensofusion Oyj was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Vantaa, Finland. Sensofusion Oyj operates as a subsidiary of Haave Oy.
